title: Targeting tumor metabolism to fight cancer
summary_en: Cancer cells are ravenous eaters. WashU’s Gary Patti is trying to turn their hunger against them.

title: Vij named inaugural Jeffrey S. and Prue H. Gershman Distinguished Professor
summary_en: Ravi Vij, MD, a national leader in the research and treatment of blood cancers, has been installed as the inaugural Jeffrey S. and Prue H. Gershman Distinguished Professor in the John T. Milliken Department of Medicine at WashU Medicine.
title_cn: Vij named inaugural Jeffrey S. and Prue H. Gershman Distinguished Professor

title: WashU Medicine’s Ritchey receives Gloria White Award
summary_en: Julie Ritchey, research laboratory manager of the lab of John DiPersio, MD, in the John T. Milliken Department of Medicine at WashU Medicine, received the 2026 Gloria W. White Distinguished Service Award. For more than three decades, Richey has worked to advance research on stem cell therapies.
title_cn: WashU Medicine’s Ritchey receives Gloria White Award

title: How Thomas Jefferson’s Quran became test case for religious liberty
summary_en: Tazeen Ali, an assistant professor of religion and politics at Washington University in St. Louis, says Thomas Jefferson’s Quran confronts us with the question of what the founders themselves knew they couldn’t avoid: Will the promises of 1776 stop at the edge of our own religion, or will they extend to Muslims and beyond?
title_cn: How Thomas Jefferson’s Quran became test case for religious liberty
